verdicts.explanation: The paper states σ300K ≈ 20 mS cm−1 for LYB at 1 bar (CHGNet_600K, Ea 0.25 eV), with Table 2 giving 19.5, and the MD/Nernst-Einstein origin is computed in this paper. The 300 K temperature is correct.
The paper reports σ300K ≈ 15.7 mS cm−1 and Ea = 0.24 eV for LYC at 10 kbar, computed in this work, and 300 K is the stated temperature.
The paper reports σ300K ≈ 0.6 mS cm−1 and Ea = 0.36 eV for LYB at 10 kbar in the text, consistent with Table 2's 0.58, and the values are computed in this paper at 300 K.

The introduction attributes the 5.36 mS cm−1 peak in the LYCB series to van der Maas et al. (Ref. 9), so literature_cited is correct; the paper gives no measurement temperature, so null is right, and the value is near x = 4.5 as stated.
